title: 704. Maximum Sum of 3 Non-Overlapping Subarrays

examples.explanation: All windows tie, so the earliest triple wins.

hints: Precompute every window sum of length k with one sliding pass.
For each position remember the best window start on its left (smallest index on ties) and on its right.
Try every middle window and join it with the best compatible left and right choices; keep the dictionary-smallest among maximal totals.
